rules.description: Every file in library/ and manifest.csv is valid UTF-8.
No output file or folder name contains \ / : * ? " < > | or a control character, is . or .., ends in a space or a dot, or is longer than 255 bytes.
A book has at most one file in library/; copies of the same book in other formats or folders are merged into it.
Every manifest row with status review gives one of the reason codes UNREADABLE, NO_TITLE, NO_AUTHOR, NO_YEAR, NO_DESCRIPTION, CONFLICT.

manifest.csv indexes the library — every library file is the path of exactly one placed row, every placed row's path is a library file and its source names at least one file of the drive (or a member of one of its archives or a row of one of its catalogs), and no source (file, archive member or catalog row) is named in more than one row.
Every file of the drive named in a review row is copied byte for byte under _review/ (archive members and catalog rows need not be).
